title: CE60102: Random Vibration
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Elementary theory of Probability; random variables; statistical moments; random
processes; convergence of random variables and processes; PSD functions;
stochastic differentiations and integrations; the Wiener process and concept of
white noise; SDOF linear systems under random inputs (time-domain and frequency
domain approaches): MDOF linear systems; introduction to Ito Calculus;
derivations of moment functions for a given linear dynamical system; Non-linear
problems; the first passage probability
